phases.name: cadence
setup: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { if (window.__rules?.game?.() !== 'eight_ball' || !window.__rules?.matchState?.()) { if ((await window.__rules?.setGame?.('eight_ball')) !== true) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); continue; } } __test.rerack(1); if (window.__rules?.setMatchState?.({ shooter: 1, breaker: 1 }) === true) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('GH-566: could not (re)establish the scripted match (game=' + (window.__rules?.game?.() ?? '?') + ', fold=' + String(!!window.__rules?.matchState?.()) + ') — a mid-scenario page reload (WebContent recycle, the #514 class) or a rules-chain failure; each attempt re-selects eight_ball, re-stages the scene and re-injects the state, so this throw means 4 s of failed recovery, not one lost race'); })()

steps.js: (() => { const n = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0]; window.__e2e.nav = n ? { domContentLoadedMs: n.domContentLoadedEventEnd, loadEventEndMs: n.loadEventEnd, durationMs: n.duration } : null; return true; })()

steps.name: scripted break accepted (cadence load)
steps.js: (() => { const err = __test.shoot({ v0: 8.5, phi: Math.PI / 2, theta: 0, a: 0, b: -0.1 }); return err == null; })()

steps.name: SC-009 rAF cadence at the 60 Hz cap: p95 <= 34 ms over the playback window (>= 120 frames)
steps.js: (() => { const ds = window.__test.frameTimes.slice(window.__e2e.f0); if (ds.length < 120) return false; const s = [...ds].sort((a, b) => a - b); const q = (p) => s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.floor(s.length * p))]; window.__e2e.raf = { n: ds.length, p50Ms: q(0.5), p95Ms: q(0.95), p99Ms: q(0.99), maxMs: s[s.length - 1] }; return window.__e2e.raf.p95Ms <= 34; })()
